Date: Fri, 19 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 + DPA: availability and proposed format

Greg —

Appreciate the clear windows and the evidence index. Proposal from our side: run a "mosaic" walkthrough — three staggered 60–90 minute blocks across two days. That keeps subject-matter experts focused and lets us surface control mappings efficiently. Rough structure:

- Block A (controls + architecture): 60–75m — infra, network, data flow mapping
- Block B (DPA & data handling): 45–60m — legal/controls owners go through evidence map
- Block C (pen-test scoping + Q&A): 30–45m — PenSure joins for scoping and risk areas

Suggested concrete slots in PST to match your windows:
- Day 1 (Tue 23 May): 13:00–14:15 Block A, 14:30–15:15 Block B
- Day 2 (Wed 24 May): 09:00–09:45 Block C + wrap (or Thu 25 May 16:00–16:45 if you prefer same-week evening)

We can deliver a short agenda (PDF) mapping evidence files to controls and a shared DocSend link. Attendees we plan to bring: Marissa (controls lead), Ben (platform + runtime), Sergio (security engineering).

Do these split slots work for Copperline? If yes, I’ll send calendar invites with bridge and the agenda attached.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-walkthrough-agenda-v2.pdf
